name: HyperliquidX 0.1.10
body:
HyperliquidX 0.1.10 fixes adding to an existing position after preparing a position action.

- Use the standard Long/Short and Place Order flow to increase an existing position. Changing direction now clears stale close, protection or reversal draft state that could incorrectly reject the order.
- Preserve the entered quantity, price, order type and time-in-force when changing direction.
- Keep existing-order, entire-position protection and active-submission direction checks in place.
